study type: Sequential-Exploratory Mixed Methods Research (protocol), including a Randomized Controlled Trial.
exposure: A training intervention based on enhanced concepts of salutogenesis theory
cohort: The study participants will be nulliparous women.
finding: This is a research protocol, therefore no findings are presented; the study aims to test whether an educational intervention based on salutogenesis theory can manage childbirth fear and influence delivery method choice.
mod_finding: The intervention aims to affect the choice of delivery method among nulliparous women.
